turn1.conflict_summary: Under Treasury Salvage Governance (SOP-REV-802 Section 4), granting a complimentary Expedited air-freight upgrade plus a brand-new Batch B-501 hardware unit is prohibited from auto-executing when an undelivered recalled order EITHER carries an existing promotional discount (Promo_Discount_Pct > 0) OR exceeds the High-Value Order Threshold (Order_Subtotal_BDT >= 25,000 BDT). Two undelivered Processing rows trigger this conflict: ORD-2026-1018 (B-409, Promo_Discount_Pct = 10%) and ORD-2026-1020 (B-409, Promo_Discount_Pct = 15%, Order_Subtotal_BDT = 28,000 BDT >= 25,000 BDT).
